home.heading: Fine metalwork from Vienna.
home.intro: From our workshop in Vienna’s 19th district we make vases, art objects and interior pieces in copper, brass and zinc — in close collaboration with designers, architects, artists and the city’s finest hotels.

atelier.heading: Three generations of craft.
body: Founded in Vienna around 1930 by [TBD: grandfather’s name], continued in the second generation by Helmut Speiser, and today in the third by Andreas Speiser, who took over the workshop in 1999.

A member of the Landesinnung Wien der Spengler und Kupferschmiede (Vienna Guild of Plumbers and Coppersmiths) since the early 1930s — recognised in 1995 for over 65 years of guild membership, and in 2024 for the 25th anniversary of Andreas Speiser’s proprietorship.

We are art metalworkers — Kunstspengler. We make fine interior pieces in metal: vases, objects, lights, cladding, hardware, restorations. No roofing, no façades. Only the pieces that live inside, close to people.
Each piece is made to order. We raise, solder, patinate, polish — by hand, by eye, with patience. For clients who care about material, proportion and surface.
